name: J. W. Ferguson et al. v. Babcock Lumber & Land Company
name_abbreviation: Ferguson v. Babcock Lumber & Land Co.

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: J. W. Ferguson et al. v. Babcock Lumber & Land Company.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 128 of the Judicial Code; Stevenson v. Fain, 195 U. S. 165; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; St. Anthony Church v. Pennsylvania R. R. Co., 237 U. S. 575, 577; Delaware, Lackawanna & Western R. R. Co. v. Yurkonis, 238 U. S. 439, 444.
See post, 570.
opinions.author: Per Curiam.

attorneys: Mr. Mark W. Brown and Mr. F. A. Sondley for appellants. Mr. John Franklin Shields and Mr. A. Hall Johnston for appellee.
casebody.head_matter:
No. 630.
J. W. Ferguson et al. v. Babcock Lumber & Land Company.
Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit.
Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted December 9, 1918.
Decided December 16, 1918.
Mr. Mark W. Brown and Mr. F. A. Sondley for appellants. Mr. John Franklin Shields and Mr. A. Hall Johnston for appellee.
